title: Time changed: “We Want You!”
text: The performance on Friday 24/07 moves from 20h20 to 21h00, at Place Général de Gaulle.

title: Good deal: happy hour at the festival courtyard
text: Half-price drinks from 6 pm to 7 pm, Thursday and Friday.

title: Remember to stay hydrated
text: It will be hot this afternoon. Water points are spread across the city: turn them on in the map filters.

title: Free shuttle from the car park
text: A shuttle connects the Edmé Vadot car park to the city center every 15 minutes, from 10 am to midnight.

title: Two waffles bought, one free
text: The Gaufres Volantes will treat you until 5 pm, near the École primaire de l'Est.

title: New slot: “MaDame”
text: An extra performance is added on Sunday. Remember to add it to your schedule.

title: Possible showers on Friday evening
text: Bring a rain jacket: the shows take place outdoors, even if it rains a little.

title: Shows love silence
text: Put your phone on silent during performances: the artists say thank you.
